description: FastAPI reporting, document-management, and integrations application with seven Snyk Code findings.

vulnerabilities.description: The report-evaluation endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to eval (Snyk: python/CodeInjection, CWE-94).
The DNS-check endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to subprocess.run with shell=True (Snyk: python/CommandInjection, CWE-78).
The report-draft endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to pickle.loads (Snyk: python/Deserialization, CWE-502).
The report-open endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to RedirectResponse without validating the destination (Snyk: python/OR, CWE-601).
The document-download endpoint passes an HTTP path parameter to FileResponse without enforcing directory containment (Snyk: python/PT, CWE-23).
The reports search endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to sqlalchemy.text in a raw SQL query (Snyk: python/Sqli, CWE-89).
The integrations preview endpoint passes an HTTP parameter to requests.get without restricting the destination (Snyk: python/Ssrf, CWE-918).
